event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 66 degrees, relative humidity 64 percent, barometer 30.19 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,025 feet, track temperature 82 degrees.

Chad Green has four round wins in his 10 races since his win in Chicago. Spencer Hyde is 6-10 in Round 1 this
year.

Hyde with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit.  Hyde is up in smoke right at the
hit and pedaled it around seven times and got it to hook up enough for the win.

Green was up in smoke right at the hit and he was off and on the throttle, but couldn't get it to hook up.

Austin Prock’s 119 round wins in FC are tied with D. Pulde for the 29th-most in class history. Prock set Low
E.T. here last year with a 3.845. Ron Capps’ last six round losses, and eight of his last nine, have all come
against current or former FC World Champions.

Prock is 8 - 2 against Capps in prior events. 

Prock with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest and fastest pass
of the weekend for the win.

Capps with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

At Rockingham, Matt Hagan became the first FC driver this year to make all eight runs — qualifying and
eliminations — in the 3-second zone. Terry Haddock is one of 19 racers who have never beaten Hagan.

Hagan is 9 - 0 against Haddock in prior events.

Hagan with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Haddock is up in smoke and clicked it off.

Jack Beckman wins 78% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice, including 91% when starting No. 1. The No.
16 FC qualifier has never won a round at this event.

Beckman is 7 - 0 against Creasy Jr. in prior events. 

Creasy with a slight starting line advantage, but Beckman has the lead as they go by the Christmas tree and
never trails from there on for the win. He make the quickest pass of the event for the win.

Creasy with his quickest and fastest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Alexis DeJoria is 17-3 in Round 1 when qualified No. 2. Bobby Bode is making his 50th career start.

DeJoria is 5 - 1 against Bode in prior events. 

DeJoria with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  She makes her quickest pass this
weekend for the win.

Bode started mixing up cylinders around half track, then the engine let go with a huge boomer.

J.R. Todd is 127-73 in Round 1 in his FC career. Blake Alexander is 1-12 against Todd in Round 1.

Todd is 14 - 2 against Alexander in prior events.

Alexander with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Todd with a good pass early and then started to spin the tires, but held on for the win.  He will give up lane
choice to Prock in the next round.

Jordan Vandergriff wins 94% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice. Cruz Pedregon is 16-36 in Round 1
when starting No. 10.

This is the first time Pedregon and Vandergriff have faced each other in eliminations. 

Pedregon with the starting line advantage, but started to spin the tires right at the hit and clicked it off.

Vandergriff with a good pass early, but the pipes got hot on the top end, but he gets the win.  He will give
up lane choice to DeJoria in next round.

The No. 8 FC qualifier is 11-3 in Round 1 at this event. This is the only Round 1 pairing between two drivers
who have not won a race.

Wilkerson is 4 - 0 against Richards in prior events. 

Wilkerson with the starting line advantage, but dropped a cylinder early.  He stayed with it to get the win.

Richards is up in smoke early and clicked it off early.
